d:
What happens when a Gen Z student, at just 14 years old, realizes the system is completely rigged and decides to take on the world's biggest fast-food corporations?
In this episode of Mind The Gap, Shrimoyee sits down with Dev Sharma, a 20-year-old University of Cambridge student and one of Britain's leading youth food activists, to talk about power, purpose and how Gen Z is rewriting the rules of politics, business and public health.
